summary_en: Anna orders lunch at a café and asks about a vegetarian option.

lines.speaker: Tjener
lines.da: Hej og velkommen. Er du alene?
lines.en: Hello and welcome. Are you on your own?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.da: Ja. Har I et ledigt bord?
lines.en: Yes. Do you have a free table?

lines.speaker: Tjener
lines.da: Ja, du kan sidde ved vinduet. Her er menukortet.
lines.en: Yes, you can sit by the window. Here is the menu.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.en: Thank you. What is the dish of the day?

lines.speaker: Tjener
lines.da: Det er fisk med kartofler og salat.
lines.en: It is fish with potatoes and salad.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.da: Jeg er vegetar. Har I noget uden kød og fisk?
lines.en: I am a vegetarian. Do you have anything without meat and fish?

lines.speaker: Tjener
lines.da: Ja, vi har en suppe med grøntsager og linser.
lines.en: Yes, we have a soup with vegetables and lentils.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.da: Det lyder godt. Er der fløde i?
lines.en: That sounds good. Is there cream in it?

lines.speaker: Tjener
lines.da: Nej, der er ikke fløde i. Suppen er vegansk.
lines.en: No, there is no cream in it. The soup is vegan.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.da: Så vil jeg gerne have den. Og et glas postevand.
lines.en: Then I would like that. And a glass of tap water.

lines.speaker: Tjener
lines.en: Would you like bread with it?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.en: Yes please, rye bread would be nice.

lines.speaker: Tjener
lines.en: Here you are. Enjoy your meal!

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.da: Ja, den var rigtig lækker. Må jeg få regningen?
lines.en: Yes, it was really delicious. May I have the bill?
